children: Binance Wallet announced on X that users can access Sports Prediction Markets through the Binance App and Binance Wallet Web. In the Binance App, the path is Exchange, then Markets, then Prediction, then Sports, or Wallet, then Home, then Prediction, then View more, then Sports. On the web, the path is Trade, then Prediction, then Sports, or Binance Wallet Web, then Prediction, then Sports. The announcement states that Prediction Markets are available only to users in eligible regions and may not be available to all users. No additional details were provided about availability beyond the regional restriction.

title: Binance Wallet Adds Access to Sports Prediction Markets
